constraints: topic, questions, answers and voiceovers in {{language}}
topic and questions must match the difficulty level specified in {{difficulty}}
Return ONLY valid JSON. No markdown, no explanations.

difficulty_calibration.Easy: Questions answerable by most adults without deep knowledge.
difficulty_calibration.Average: Questions requiring general knowledge or common school-level facts.
difficulty_calibration.Hard: Questions requiring specialized knowledge or uncommon facts.

reference_example.intro_voiceover: Today we ask about everyday science. Can you get all five right?
reference_example.like_and_subscribe_voiceover: Like this video and subscribe to our channel for more quizzes like this!

questions.question: What planet is known as the Red Planet?

remotion_mapping.input_props: The entire output_schema JSON is passed as inputProps.
assets_pipeline: each question → TTS → per-question audio clip
